selection_policy: Select the most recently published non-draft release from the official repository, including a pre-release. A lagging operational guide does not downgrade it.

releases.summary: Respins Musashi, requires fresh local state, and requires a registered BLS signing key for block-producer voting.
releases.state_action: Preserve the prior local state, then remove or quarantine it and re-sync from genesis with the current Musashi configuration. Start producers with --shelley-bls-key.

releases.summary: Hotfix changes invalid Leios certificate failures from node crashes to InvalidBlock traces.
releases.state_action: If crashes continue after updating, first delete only volatile chain state.

releases.summary: Adds EB announcement diffusion, exposes the BLS Leios key through cardano-api, and adds Linux aarch64 binaries.
releases.state_action: No state wipe required; updating relays together is recommended.

releases.summary: Adds BLS key registration plumbing and Dijkstra ledger fixes; the BLS key is required by the registration command but is not utilized yet.
releases.state_action: Release notes require wiping local state and sideloading from IOG relays or syncing from genesis.

releases.summary: Increases certification throughput, adds CallTrace instrumentation, and caps oversized FetchLogic logs.
Fixes missing Leios database tables, block re-application, and uncertified EB application on startup.
Fixes permanent stalling while syncing from genesis.
Improves stability but still suffers from sync-from-genesis stalls.
Breaking block and EB encoding changes; the release title explicitly marks it broken.
releases.state_action: Requires a Musashi respin, local-state deletion, and new network configuration.

releases.summary: Fixes Dijkstra CLI transaction commands and adds macOS arm64 binaries.
Improves block-fetch stability and Dijkstra stake and governance queries.
Adds voting pipeline work and a breaking N2N vote wire-format change.
First public cardano-node leios-prototype release, based on Dijkstra-enabled node 11.0.1.

conflicts: The getting-started guide still embeds prototype-2026w30 examples while the official release repository and live Musashi configuration select prototype-2026w32.
The exact cardano-node version string is verified from the running w32 flake environment; the network configuration declares MinNodeVersion 11.1.0-prototype-2026w32.
